subject: Customer purge request — runbook, verification, and final confirmation
messages:
From: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@finovate.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Finovate Health (FV-3145)

Hi Dylan,

We need to submit a formal deletion request for Finovate Health (account ID: FV-3145). Scope: all prompt inputs, model-generated outputs, and derived logs (including KV cache traces and temporary inference artifacts) created under the production workspace since 2025-01-01.

Can you confirm Redwood's planned steps, estimated time-to-complete, and what evidence you will provide (timestamped manifest + sweep logs)? Our security team requires a signed confirmation and machine-readable manifest listing deleted objects.

Please treat as high priority — Finovate must complete its compliance attestation by EOD Aug 21.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Wu
Data Privacy Lead, Finovate Health

Attachments: none
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@finovate.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Finovate Health (FV-3145)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the ticket. I’ve looped in Marcus from Ops and Neha from Compliance so we can scope and execute.

Quick confirmation questions before we run:
- Confirm scope: production workspace only, all token-level prompt inputs, assistant outputs, embeddings derived for that account, and ephemeral inference logs?
- Any exclusion windows (snapshots/backups) older than 90 days that you want preserved?

Planned approach (high level):
1) Lock write operations to impacted tenancy to prevent new artifacts.
2) Run targeted sweeps: prompt-output store, KV cache eviction, embedding index pruning.
3) Expunge entries and record deletions into a manifest (JSON).
4) Provide sweep logs + manifest + signed statement of completion.

Marcus, please review and confirm estimated wall-clock time and whether we need to schedule a maintenance window for snapshot immutability. Neha — will you need the standard 3rd-party attestation template or a custom statement for Finovate?

I’ll prepare a runbook and share a Drive link. Targeting completion within 48 hours after scope confirmation.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Finovate Health (FV-3145) — Ops checklist and runbook

Hi all — I’ve drafted the execution checklist below and attached the runbook (purge_runbook_v1.2.pdf). Short summary: this is a scoped deletion — no tenant-wide lock required, but we will snapshot metadata indices before sweep. Estimated wall-clock: 6–10 hours of coordinated execution, plus post-run verification (manifest generation and evidence packaging) ~2 hours.

Execution checklist (technical):
- Pre-check: verify exact workspace ID and tenant GUID (we have FV-3145 mapped to tenant guid: rwd-92f6).
- Snapshot current indices (store snapshot retained for 7 days, encrypted, for legal hold).
- Prefix-scan and delete: prompt-store (prefixes: /prod/FV-3145/prompts/*), output-store (/prod/FV-3145/outputs/*).
- KV cache eviction: remove all cached keys tied to tenant GUID, rotate session nonces.
- Embeddings index: run reindex excluding deleted docs, prune orphan vectors.
- Audit logging: write deletion events to immutable audit bucket and generate a manifest (erase_manifest_FV-3145.json).
- Sweep log: produce CSV of deleted object keys (sweep-log-20260820.csv).
- Post-check: recompute service-level artifacts to ensure system stability.

Notes/risks:
- Backups older than retention window (90 days) will not be deleted unless explicitly requested — please confirm if Finovate requires that.
- There will be transient latency to the inference caches during eviction; we can do a rolling sweep to reduce impact.

I’ve uploaded the runbook and a read-only Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRunbookLink (contains step-by-step scripts).

If you confirm the scope (production only, no longer-retained backups), we’ll schedule the sweep for Friday, Aug 20 at 09:00 PT and expect evidence delivered by EOD Aug 20.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: purge_runbook_v1.2.pdf

Sarah
